extractedWith: tools/extract/extract.ps1 -Batch p9-usecase-testing -Manifest <scratch copy of allowlist.manifest.yaml with the p9-usecase-testing batch> -Clean (scrub findings and one known-secret-digest finding in the staged command are expected before the rewrite; nothing from them was carried)
promotion: Each staged file was read as a reference only and rewritten with starter names and structure; "target" is the repo file it informed, "stagedTarget" the path in the staging folder. Content is a rewrite, so the repo file hash differs from stagedSha256. The skill and the command are merged into one skill (commands become skills): input is a use-case ID plus any HLS-format workbook path (no fixed docs folder or workbook version), the live stack is a run-local -Slot stack on its own throwaway database, and the report is an .xlsx or a Markdown bug report generated from results.json by a PowerShell script (no Python). Left behind: the source product's roles, ports, service names, test project names, docs folders and versions, seeded account names and the password, machine-specific SQL notes and every findings sample.

origins.note: Kept: the phase structure (inspect, read workbook, plan, run existing tests, investigate, root cause, report), the two oracle rules (workbook wins; a gap is not a defect), honest Confirmed/Probable confidence, Blocked never Pass, and always emitting a report. Rewritten for any project: no hard-coded workbook folder or version, starter test map, slot stack, no Python generator.

The sheet-by-sheet workbook table and the error-handling table were generalized (match by header text, any generation); the results.json contract, severity and confidence rubrics and the tracing chain were written for the starter's layers.

The Markdown findings template became the -Format Markdown output of scripts/Write-UseCaseReport.ps1 (sections and issue fields kept, shaped for prd-and-plan). The role list, port list, test project names, seed accounts and password were not carried.

Report sections and the per-issue fields (problem, expected, actual, repro, root cause, location, fix, acceptance criteria, blast radius) informed the generated report; counts are derived by the script.

Approach kept (System.IO.Compression OOXML read, shared strings with rich and phonetic runs, inline strings, relationship-resolved sheets). Added -Sheet, -AsJson, -OutFile (UTF-8), booleans, cells without a reference, terminating errors, strict mode, ASCII-only source for Windows PowerShell 5.1; Pester 3.4 tests build the workbook in %TEMP%.
